method: Greedy card heuristic; five first available heroes; starter deck plus the first offered card after each victory, skipping at 25 cards; no camp purchases, upgrades or scepter; eight fixed seeds per growth path. Each multi-scene stage plays every scene in order — a defeat retries only that scene conceptually, but a lost scene fails the journey here. Choice events resolve deterministically to option A. Failed journeys stop immediately; no forced wins.
